headline: West Texas A&M go three matches without a goal
dek: West Texas A&M scored four and kept a clean sheet against Adams State on the opening day, and have not scored since, losing at home to Fort Lewis and away at Colorado Christian and Southern Nazarene. Their eleven goals conceded are matched only by Sul Ross State, who have yet to score at all.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Eight different players have scored Midwestern State's fourteen goals, and Jose Ortiz has five of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian's unbeaten start is over; Midwestern State, Texas A&M International and UT Tyler are the sides yet to lose.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no result published, among them Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, and St. Edward's against Southwestern.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all three of their matches without scoring, and have conceded eleven.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Midwestern State have won both matches at home and drawn both away, scoring fourteen and conceding four.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won three, drawn one and lost one, and their ten goals are more than Lubbock Christian and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made twenty-three saves for Sul Ross State and has yet to keep a clean sheet.

last_match.line: Midwestern State are still unbeaten, and have yet to win away from home.

next_match.line: Sul Ross State have yet to score this season; St. Mary's come in off their first win.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
